pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown, irregularly shaped polygonal regions with high-frequency jagged edges. The spatial area of patches decreases significantly toward the proximal forelimb and lower neck, with individual patches exhibiting soft pixel-level gradients at their margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored negative space. Corridors are narrow with uniform pixel thickness, forming distinct Y-junction and cross-junction nodes between contiguous dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a short, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper cervical ridge, with low amplitude against the blurred background.
